subject.title: refactor(slack)!: retire inline interactive directives for typed presentation

question: Should OpenClaw remove the documented `@openclaw/slack` interactive-reply helper exports in this release, or preserve them as deprecated compatibility APIs while users migrate to typed presentation actions?
rationale: The config migration is mechanically safe, but removal of a published API is an external compatibility policy choice that cannot be resolved by the Doctor migration or tests alone.

options.title: Keep deprecated exports temporarily
options.body: Retain the existing public helpers with a clear deprecation notice and migration documentation while typed presentation becomes the recommended path.

options.title: Approve immediate API removal
options.body: Accept a deliberate source-breaking change now and document the required migration for all external `@openclaw/slack` consumers.

recommendation.title: Keep deprecated exports temporarily
recommendation.body: Retain the existing public helpers with a clear deprecation notice and migration documentation while typed presentation becomes the recommended path.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Slack compatibility refactor and its stated breaking-change rationale originate from this contributor.
